Name: Cute Children by Twilight
Author: Tuairaito
Description:
[center][size=5]🌸Hello!!!🌸[/size][/center]
[size=3]I made this mod for personal use at first, but I thought that maybe someone else would like it too, so I decided to post it.
It's a mod to retexture the farmer's kids to look cuter AND look alike your Stardew spouse!
[i][size=2]❀ Um mod de retextura dos filhos do fazendeiro(a), para ficar mais fofinho e parecer mais com seu esposo(a)![/size][/i][/size]

[size=3]Hope yall like it! ✨[/size]
[i]❀ Espero que gostem![/i][size=3][i]✨[/i][/size]

[size=3]If you're interested in a more vanillaish style, take a look at [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/552][size=3]Babies Take After Spouses[/size][/url][size=3], which was the inspiration for my mod![/size][i][size=2]
❀ O link acima é uma versão que me serviu de inspiração, ela é mais parecida com os filhos base do jogo.[/size][/i]

[size=5]🌸 Retextures ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~[/size]

[size=3]~~~~~> Kids textures [b]currently available [/b]<~~~~~[/size]
[size=3][u]Husband's[/u] -[i] [/i]Alex; Elliott; Harvey; Sam and Sebastian.[/size]
[size=3][u]Wife's[/u] - Abigail; Emily, Haley, Leah and Maru.[/size]

[size=3]I only made retextures for a few spouses, BUT [u]I will be updating[/u] with the others, I promise![/size]

[size=3]Also, there's 4 skin tones for you to choose![/size]
[size=3]You can select it in game if you have [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3] installed, or you can manually change it﻿ in the '[/size][i]config.json'[/i][size=3] that will appear into the '[i][CP] [/i][/size][i]Cute Children by Twilight'[/i][size=3] folder when you start the game for the first time after installing the mod :)[/size]

[i][size=3]❀[/size][size=2] [i]No momento só tem textura dos filhos para alguns esposos, MAS eu [u]vou estar atualizando[/u] com os outros, eu prometo![/i] [/size]
[size=2][i]❀ [/i]Há 4 tons de pele para selecionar pelo jogo via Generic Mod Config Menu (as opções aparecem em pt-br) ou no arquivo 'config.json' (opções apenas em inglês) que vai aparecer dentro da pasta do meu mod após iniciar o jogo com ele pela primeira vez :)[/size][/i]

[size=5]🌸 How to install ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~[/size]

[size=3]1 - Place it anywhere in your stardew [u]mods folder;[/u]
2 - Unzip the file;[/size]
[size=3]3 - Start the game and have fun!✨[/size]

[size=4]❀ [b]Como instalar:[/b][/size]
[size=3]1 - Coloque em qualquer lugar dentro da [/size][u][size=3]pasta de mods[/size][/u][size=3] do Stardew;[/size]
[size=3]2 - Descompacte o arquivo zip;[/size]
[size=3]3 - Inicie o jogo e se divirta!✨[/size]
